title: Seth Klarman
html: Who: Runs Baupost, known for decades of strong, risk-averse returns. Core ideas: Margin of safety; holding cash is fine when nothing is cheap; patience is an edge most investors lack. Read: Margin of Safety (out of print, famously expensive). For our plan: Keep an emergency fund in cash so we're never forced to sell SPY at a bad time. Back to Council of Masters
